:_mod-docs-content-type: PROCEDURE

[id="enabling-model-cache_{context}"]
= Enable model cache

[role="_abstract"]
You can enable model cache on your {productname-short} cluster to pre-download large models to local node storage.
Enabling model cache requires editing the `inferenceservice-config` ConfigMap and preparing the infrastructure on your target nodes.

.Prerequisites

* You have cluster administrator privileges for your {openshift-platform} cluster.
* You have installed {productname-long} 3.5 or later with `KServe`.
* You have installed the {openshift-cli}.
* Enough local disk space is available on the target GPU nodes, or a `StorageClass` is available for network volume provisioning.

.Procedure

. Edit the `inferenceservice-config` ConfigMap to enable model cache:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc edit configmap inferenceservice-config -n {dbd-config-default-namespace}
----

. In the ConfigMap, add or update the `localModel` section in the `data` field:
+
[source,yaml]
----
data:
  localModel: |-
    {
      "enabled": true,
      "jobNamespace": "<job_namespace>", <1>
      "defaultJobImage": "<download_job_image>", <2>
      "fsGroup": 1000 <3>
    }
----
+
--
Where:

`<job_namespace>`:: Specifies the namespace where model download jobs run.
If you do not specify a value, download jobs run in the default namespace.
Create this namespace if it does not exist.
`<download_job_image>`:: Specifies the container image used for model download jobs.
In disconnected environments, this image must be available from a mirrored registry.
`fsGroup`:: Specifies the group ID for file system permissions on downloaded model files.
Set this value to `1000` to match the default user in the download job container.
--

. If you specified a custom `jobNamespace`, create it:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc create namespace <job_namespace>
----

. On each target GPU node, set the correct ownership for the host directory where you store models:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ sudo chown 1000:1000 /mnt/models
----
+
Replace `/mnt/models` with the path where you plan to store cached models.
This path must match the `local.path` value in the `LocalModelNodeGroup` persistent volume spec that you create later.

. For Kustomize-based installations, label each target node to enable the model cache agent DaemonSet scheduling:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc label node <node_name> kserve/localmodel=worker
----
+
Replace `<node_name>` with the name of each GPU node where you want to cache models.
+
[NOTE]
====
Helm-based installations use persistent volume `nodeAffinity` for scheduling and do not require this label.
====

.Verification

. Verify that the model cache controller pod is running:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get pods -n {dbd-config-default-namespace} -l control-plane=localmodel-controller
----
+
The output shows the controller pod in a `Running` state.

. Verify that the `inferenceservice-config` ConfigMap has the `localModel` section:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get configmap inferenceservice-config -n {dbd-config-default-namespace} -o jsonpath='{.data.localModel}' | python3 -m json.tool
----
+
The output shows the `localModel` configuration with `enabled` set to `true`.
